title: VTC Events — Create — payload
description: Create a draft event or meeting in a calendar. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

calendarId.description: The calendar it belongs to. Absent: the community's own calendar.

kind.description: Absent means `event`. Fixed for the event's life (VTI-EVT-003).

roster.description: Absent: the calendar's `defaultRoster`, else `hidden`. Fixed once published (VTI-EVT-051).

showCount.description: Show the number going to the audience, subject to `countThreshold`.

countThreshold.description: Below this many going, a count is shown as `fewerThan`. Absent means 5.

listed.description: Listed to its whole audience. Absent means true.

suggestedReminderMinutes.description: Reminders the hosts suggest, as minutes before the start. Absent: the calendar's `defaultReminderMinutes`.

Response.title: VTC Events — Create — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/create/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/create/0.1#response.

event.description: The draft as its host sees it.
